cardEffects:
[Security] Play this card without battling and without paying the cost.
[On Play] If you have a [Mother D-Reaper] in play, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[Opponent's Turn] While you have a [Mother D-Reaper] with 6 or more digivolution cards in play, all of your opponent's Digimon get ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.)

jp.captionText: EX-02: Theme Booster Digital Hazard (JP Sample)

name: ADR-09 Gatekeeper

references.text: Official JP Q&A for EX2-054 (translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No. Cards that don't have levels can't be digivolved from, and you can't digivolve into this card. (Other than through special digivolutions.)
rulings.question: This card doesn't have a level. Can I still digivolve into it and into other cards?

rulings.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.
rulings.question: If this card's effect plays a Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?

rulings.answer: Yes. This card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect gives your opponent’s attacking Digimon <Security Attack -1> before the second security check, so the second security check does not occur, and the attack ends.
rulings.question: An opponent’s Digimon with <Security Attack+1> attacks me directly, and this card is flipped over during the first security check and played in my battle area by its [Security] effect. If I have a [Mother D-Reaper] with 6 or more digivolution cards in play, can this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect prevent my opponent's second security check?

rulings.answer: No. From the time it plays by this effect, it is treated as a normal Digimon.
rulings.question: Are Digimons played by the effect of this card treated as Security Digimon in the Battle Area?

rulings.answer: Yes, it activates ≪Security Attack-1≫ on the attacking opponent's Digimon by this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect before the second check, so the second check is not performed and the attack is over.
